name: Drunken noodles (pad kee mao)
assumptions: Recipe serves 2 adults as a main dish based on 225g steak + 200g noodles + vegetables for a stir-fry meal.
Preparation time estimated from instructions: ~5 min sauce/noodles prep + ~4-5 min active stir-frying = 10-15 min total; rounded up conservatively to 15 min including chopping.
Oyster sauce classified as containing shellfish (oysters).
Soy sauce and wheat-based flat rice noodles treated as containing wheat (not certified gluten-free).
Basil assumed to be Thai holy basil but nutrition uses standard fresh basil values; does not affect classification.
All gram weights and assumptions from provided data used directly; no additional ingredients inferred.
instructions:
step 1
Prepare the noodles following pack instructions, then drain and set aside. Combine all the ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl or jug, and set aside.

step 2
Heat the oil in a large wok or frying pan over a high heat and stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 20 seconds until just starting to turn golden. Add the steak and stir-fry for 1 minute until seared and starting to brown. Add the broccoli and stir-fry for another minute, then tip in the noodles and add the sauce. Stir-fry for another 1-2 mins until well combined and piping hot.

step 3
Stir through the basil and turn off the heat. Serve immediately to avoid overcooking.

ingredients.name: Flat Rice Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Dry flat rice noodles (pad thai style); typical package nutrition before boiling, as recipe directs to prepare per pack then drain.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil (standard 15 ml per tbsp, density ~0.92 g/ml).

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 3 average garlic cloves, chopped (≈3 g each); standard raw garlic values.

ingredients.name: Birds-eye Chillies
ingredients.assumptions: 3 birds-eye chillies (≈5 g each whole); typical fresh red chilli nutrition, chopped.

ingredients.name: Sirloin steak
ingredients.assumptions: Raw sirloin steak, trimmed; standard lean beef sirloin values for stir-fry.

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh broccoli florets, raw weight as added to stir-fry.

ingredients.name: Basil Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: A generous handful of Thai holy basil leaves (≈20 g); typical fresh basil leaves.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tablespoons regular soy sauce (15 ml each, density ≈1 g/ml); standard sodium-reduced not assumed.

ingredients.name: Oyster Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tablespoons oyster sauce (15 ml each); typical bottled values.

ingredients.name: Fish Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1 teaspoon fish sauce (≈5 g); standard Southeast Asian fish sauce.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon white sugar (12 g); standard granulated sugar.
